name: spring-fest
comments: Firebase App Hosting entry point for the whole repo (root directory = /).
The Node buildpack runs: npm install -> npm run build -> npm start.
`build` compiles the Vite SPA into frontend/dist; `start` runs the Express
server (backend/server.js), which serves both /api and that SPA build.
dependencies here mirror backend/package.json so they land in the runtime
image. backend/ and frontend/ keep their own package.json for local dev.

scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix frontend run build
